title: Quenched Pillow French Nduja Tatin
description: A plant-based French dish inspired by Tatin, featuring nduja and a crispy, pillowy texture. This date-night classic from Lyon is sure to impress.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the nduja, date jam, and thyme.
In a large ceramic tagine, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the sliced red onion and cook until caramelized.
Add the chopped red pepper and artichoke to the tagine, cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Spread the nduja-date jam mixture evenly over the top of the vegetables.
Crumble the cottage cheese and plant-based cream cheese over the nduja mixture.
Drizzle the render-fat over the top of the cheese mixture.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Quenched Pillow French Nduja Tatin hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Garnish with a sprinkle of black pepper and a dollop of plant-based cream cheese, if desired.
